prompt:
Workflow step: Use the mobile robot arm to move the test tube from dispensing device to test tube rack 2.
Inspection timing: after this step
Inspection location: test tube rack 2
What the inspection checks: Check on test tube rack 2 whether there is a uncapped test tube containing transparent liquid with a small amount of colored fluid at the top.

A description of the inspection camera's photograph follows, written by someone who was not told what is being checked.

Description: Low-angle shot looking up at lab equipment against a pale wall and white ceiling. Right of centre, a vertical aluminium extrusion column runs from bottom to top, with a bolted metal plate (about eight visible screws) mid-height and a small grey sensor or camera clipped near its top, a thin black cable hanging down from it. At lower left, a black slotted tube rack or holder sits on a white/grey base; one tube is visible in it, capped with an orange cap, its body white/clear. Behind the rack is a purple-and-white sign bearing a QR-style code; a second black-and-white marker tag appears at bottom centre. A white wall sign at right reads "...Area".
observations: The test tube in the rack is capped with an orange cap, failing the requirement for an uncapped test tube.
